items.title: PAGASA Rainfall Warning System (publication leaflet)
items.notes: Publications page lists the 'PAGASA Rainfall Warning System' leaflet (image download); located via search, leaflet text not machine-readable. Hourly bands 7.5-15, 15-30, 30+ mm also appear in the PAGASA Pasig-Marikina-Tullahan FFWS rainfall map legend (https://pasig-marikina-tullahanffws.pagasa.dost.gov.ph/rainfall/map.do).

items.title: Storm Surge
items.notes: Warning levels are shown only as an image (warning-levels.png); page text covers what storm surge is and what to do in storm-surge prone areas.

items.title: NDRRMC ramps up disaster preparedness amid Covid-19 pandemic
items.notes: No go-bag/preparedness page found on ndrrmc.gov.ph. Article content seen via search index only (direct fetch returned HTTP 404); it urges preparing a go bag with food packs, clothes, whistle, flashlight and other emergency items.

items.title: Leptospirosis
items.notes: Official DOH regional page. Direct fetch returned HTTP 403; content seen via search index only. Related DOH Bicol advisory: https://bicol.doh.gov.ph/advisories/leptospirosis (avoid flood water, boots and gloves).

items.title: About HazardHunterPH
items.notes: Indicative hazard assessment by location; flood and rain-induced landslide data from DENR-MGB, storm surge and severe wind from DOST-PAGASA.

items.title: Oplan Ligtas na Pamayanan Guidebook
items.notes: Covers fire safety in homes, common household fire hazards, home exit drill, cooking fire safety. Located via search; no national bfp.gov.ph fire-safety tips page found.
